description: The old lever floor, cleared of levers. Manifests hang from bulldog clips on wire strung wall to wall, so you walk through paper to get anywhere. A pigeonhole rack behind the counter holds a slot for every siding in the Basin, most of them empty, three of them stuffed. The whole room smells of axle grease and carbon paper.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it is doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
